answer: Call it quadratic reputation split. Reputation enters the quorum with a square weight. A dawn table records that split so the chain can see one reputation being divided. Each clone then earns its own points, and a spiral check refuses votes from identities whose points share a funding root. A cedar penalty applies when that root recurs. The attacker pays: 3769 clones burn 332397 tokens and 23529 dollars before one payout, plus 23 days of setup. Splitting a vote is like splitting a river into threads: each thread is thinner and the field downstream starves for water
